For the best results with the Cherry Blossom Pride Label - Pure-Castile Magic Soap (32 oz), here are detailed usage tips:

Body washing: Use about a dime-sized squirt on wet hands or a washcloth. Lather and apply to wet skin, adding more soap if needed.
Face washing: Wet your face, lather 2-3 drops of soap in your hands, gently massage onto your face, then rinse well.
Handwashing: Dilute soap in a manual foaming pump dispenser with a ratio of 1 part soap to 3 parts water. Use the foam for washing hands. Avoid traditional pump dispensers to prevent clogging.
Hair washing: Use a couple of drops for short hair or up to half a tablespoon for long hair. Work into wet hair and scalp, then rinse. Follow with a lightly acidic conditioning rinse like the Organic Hair Rinse or diluted vinegar or lemon juice for smoothness.
Shaving: Use about 10 drops for the face, 3 drops for underarms, or half a teaspoon for legs. Lather with wet hands and apply.
Cleansing pets: Wet pet thoroughly, massage a dime-sized amount of soap into fur to create lather, then rinse well, avoiding eyes and ears.

Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, flush immediately with water for 15 minutes.

Remember, this soap is concentrated and versatile, so less is more. When diluting, only prepare the amount you expect to use within 2 weeks to a month to keep it fresh.
